results.name: Quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension
results.scope: Hausdorff dimension of the real Feigenbaum attractor with a quartic critical point.
results.verification: Independent 256-bit interval pressure calculation over 16,344 cells per endpoint, including the fixed-point function error.
results.note: Width 2.130433 × 10⁻⁹. The comparison is with the cited rigorous quartic enclosure; Pollicott’s later result concerns the quadratic attractor.
